name: ZCA_AI_LLM_RESPONSE_STORE
description: ZCA_AI_LLM_RESPONSE_STORE : This table stores the responses generated by a LLM (Large Language Model). The table is designed to store unique responses for each combination of object id, object type, prompt code, and language

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Auto generated primary key of the table

columns.name: KEY
columns.description: A unique key generated by hashing the combination of Object, ObjectType, PromptCode, and Lang

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The ID of the object for which the response was generated. Eg, OptyId

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of object for which the response was generated. Eg, Opportunity

columns.name: PROMPT_CODE
columns.description: The code of the prompt used to generate the response.

columns.name: LANG
columns.description: The language code in which the response was generated

columns.name: GENERATED_CONTENT
columns.description: The response corresponding to key generated by LLM

columns.name: VARIABLE_INPUT_HASH
columns.description: A hash of the variable input values used to generate the response.

columns.name: PROMPT_HASH
columns.description: A hash of the prompt used to generate the response

columns.name: ACCESS_GROUP_HASH
columns.description: A hash of the access group associated with the response.

columns.name: EXPIRY_DATE
columns.description: Timestamp when the response is considered stale, calculated by adding the TTL (Time To Live) to the CreationDate.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
